stories.title: IIIT-H Develops Accessibility Tool For Hearing Impaired
stories.synopsis: Researchers at IIIT Hyderabad built a simple browser plugin that lets you select text on a web page and watch a 3D avatar sign it in Indian Sign Language. It runs in real time in the browser without special hardware or an AI model on a server. When tested with deaf and hard-of-hearing signers, they understood about 89% of the avatar's signed sentences.

stories.title: AI model helps some patients get diagnoses after years of uncertainty: Study
stories.synopsis: A study in the New England Journal of Medicine found an AI model is helping some patients get answers after years of unexplained illness. It acts as an extra set of eyes for specialists, sifting through complex information in about six to 10 minutes per case. The researchers stress it doesn't replace doctors or genetic specialists, and it shows why old genetic test results may be worth a second look.

stories.title: A Sweeter Future? AI Helps Scientists Discover New Sugar Substitutes
stories.source: American Friends of the Hebrew University (AFHU)
stories.synopsis: Researchers at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem combined machine learning with molecular modeling to screen more than 50 million chemical compounds. They narrowed the list to 92 promising candidates for future sugar alternatives, aiming for sweetness without the bitter aftertaste. The candidates still need experimental validation, but the study in Food Chemistry offers a hopeful new way to search for tastier sweeteners.
